items.q: like Ella Fitzgerald sang sometimes, she goes (scatting)

ctx.x: Yeah, this is Lucius? Now, what Lucius would do with the trumpet, where I would write for them, when they would take an outcourse, like, they would be singing, and when they'd do the outcourse, then -- like Ella Fitzgerald sang sometimes, she goes (scatting), --
